result.note: Tests the nationalities of the accused and the location of the alleged drone-warfare training in the NIA case.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the National Investigation Agency (NIA) filed charges in a case of alleged drone-warfare training of armed groups. Consider the following statements:
items: The accused included six Russian nationals.
The alleged training was given to anti-India armed groups in Myanmar.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The NIA charged a US citizen and six Ukrainians, not Russians. Russia figures only as the possible source of the intelligence used to track them, according to the agency.
questions.source: The NIA charged a US citizen and six Ukrainians over alleged drone-warfare training of anti-India armed groups in Myanmar
